name: bld6_chebyshev_T_separable
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_chebyshev_T_card_distinct_real_roots and Mathlib2.lib_chebyshev_T_natDegree_le: n = #distinct roots ≤ card roots ≤ natDegree ≤ n (the first equality from the poly theorem, the last bound from the lib lemma), so T_n has natDegree n, splits over ℝ with all roots simple; a polynomial with natDegree-many distinct roots is squarefree, hence separable in characteristic 0.
